# TaxFreely — robots.txt
#
# This file is intentionally permissive. The entire site — the tool itself
# and every guide page under /guides/ — is meant to be indexed.
#
# The sitemap referenced below does not exist yet. It is generated by
# scripts/generateGuides.js during the website phase (messages 52-58).
# Once that script runs, dist/sitemap.xml is created automatically on
# every build, and the line below becomes live without any further edit
# to this file.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Netlify Functions are API endpoints, not content — no reason for any
# crawler to index them, and doing so would just waste crawl budget.
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /.netlify/

Sitemap: https://taxfreely.com/sitemap.xml
